description: Upscale images 2x or 4x with neural super-resolution. Uses Real-ESRGAN (ICCV 2021, PSNR 32.73dB on Set5 4x, 100M+ production runs). Recovers real detail from low-resolution images — not interpolation. Optional face enhancement. Stable endpoint — model upgrades automatically as SOTA evolves. 5 sats per image, pay per request with Bitcoin Lightning — no API key or signup needed. Requires create_payment with toolName='upscale_image'.

face_enhance.description: Apply face enhancement during upscaling (default false)

imageBase64.description: Base64-encoded image (PNG, JPEG, WEBP) or data URI

name: upscale_image
